definitions.required: All declared scalar outputs, including failed and unrun jobs.
definitions.reported: Unique named reference-check slots returned, including null/nonfinite predictions.
definitions.finite: Reported finite numeric predictions, even from a failed numerical job.
definitions.numerically_valid_finite: Finite predictions from jobs whose numerical checks passed.
definitions.passed: Numerically valid finite predictions satisfying the original unchanged precision rule.
definitions.absent: Required scalar slots with no returned reference check.
definitions.reported_unavailable: Reported slots with no finite prediction; never substituted with zero.
definitions.unsupported_required: Required slots in explicitly unsupported adapter scopes; distinct from numerical/input failures.
definitions.failed_job_required: Required slots in completed numerical/input/process failures; excludes explicitly unsupported and unrun jobs.
definitions.metrics: RMSE/max absolute error use numerically valid finite predicted/reference pairs only; exclusions retain explicit counts.
definitions.force_units: Polar lift/drag use the literal model Unit F declaration, reported per table. No unit normalization is fitted.
definitions.coefficient_units: CL, CD, CDi, Cm, span efficiency and CT are dimensionless (1).

limitations: Selected scope matches do not establish complete family reproduction or recovered historical settings.
Aggregate scalar pass fractions are not a validation or completion percentage: counts include multiple meshes, repeated output recoveries and exact-zero channels.
Fine-grid means the larger of the two predeclared counts, not demonstrated mesh convergence.
No new mesh/reference threshold or near-zero percentage metric is introduced.
Original source import results and test evidence are separate from scalar output agreement.
